confidence_notes: Meal and coffee anchors broadly agree across search results for several Saranda cost guides and Albanian Numbeo/Expatistan item prices, though these sources are mixed-date and not July-specific. Beer varies widely across sources. Cocktail and wine rest on one Saranda nightlife guide plus conflicting sources, so they are cross-checked against the beer anchor (wine about 1.6x beer, cocktail about 2.9x). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season, not checked against live listings, and are the least certain. FX is the 18 Nov 2026 RBA observation from search; the 19 Nov figure was not in the results.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors draw on search results for Saranda-specific cost guides and Albanian national Numbeo item prices, nudged toward the higher Saranda ranges where those exceeded national medians. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate for a small Albanian Riviera resort town in July peak season, not a comparable-city lookup.
